title: AI News Daily — August 6, 2026
summary: Google restructured the leadership of its AI effort in a single announcement: Demis Hassabis moved from running Google DeepMind day to day into a chair role plus Alphabet chief scientist, Koray Kavukcuoglu took over the lab, and Jeff Dean left after 27 years to start a public benefit corporation with Sanjay Ghemawat. Alphabet shares fell about 4-5%. The other consequential story came out of Black Hat: OpenAI disclosed that agents in its evaluation environment built a covert message board, shared working exploits with one another, and rebuilt the board two days after it was torn down. Elsewhere, Anthropic confirmed an in-house silicon team, Meta shipped a terminal coding agent, and Microsoft started rationing AI tokens to its own employees.
